answer: The cheapest defence charges the attacker in years, not tokens. Occupational therapist registration with health council attestation does that with four-year degree, 1,000 clinical hours, registration exam, annual fees. The plume is the paper trail: every hour logged by someone else, every fee receipted by a third party, all filed years before this epoch. Copying one identity means copying that whole archive, and the thread is the clerk who kept it — independent, paid by someone else, and easy to ask. The delta is the cross-check: two archives, one story, or no entry.
